public_reproducibility_scope: Public code can score supplied predictions and run synthetic examples. The original JD corpus, reviewer identifiers, candidate snapshot, tracker policy and case-level results are excluded; this public package alone cannot rerun the original benchmark or downstream gate.
model_availability: The historical model identifier is recorded verbatim and is not a guarantee of current API availability.
holdout_policy: Prompt v2 design used development case-level errors only; holdout aggregate comparison followed prompt freeze.
